PROBE FINDING (root-caused, not tuned): the endogenous split holds 2.1-2.4x the measured battery AS award in every year (2023 mean 2,625 vs 1,249 MW) because it lacks the published per-product duration requirements (ECRS 2-h / Non-Spin 4-h sustained); the surplus reserve floods the total-ORDC family and collapses the 2023 scarcity months (Aug -76.4 vs keeper -46.1). C3 fails are the probe's own artifacts, deliberately MODEL MISS - no adder applied.
